msa_selection_frozen_before_retrieval.purpose: Small source-audited receptor homolog alignment; not a full MMseqs database MSA or guaranteed structure remedy.
msa_selection_frozen_before_retrieval.reference: Existing Q92843 canonical full sequence; project only unchanged query positions 1-164; do not change Q133.
msa_selection_frozen_before_retrieval.source: UniProtKB canonical BCL2L2-annotated vertebrate records; reviewed and unreviewed disclosed; gene annotation plus alignment supports homolog candidates, not independently proved orthology.
msa_selection_frozen_before_retrieval.alignment: Global Bio.Align.PairwiseAligner with BLOSUM62, open gap -10, extend gap -0.5 against full Q92843; project the first 164 reference residues; insertions lowercase in A3M.
msa_selection_frozen_before_retrieval.one_per_taxon: Prefer reviewed, then higher coverage, then higher core identity, then accession.
msa_selection_frozen_before_retrieval.if_more_than_64: Deterministic farthest-first selection on projected match-column identities including query; accession tie-break. No prediction/affinity readouts used.
msa_selection_frozen_before_retrieval.floor_interpretation: Engineering input-readiness floor fixed before retrieving sequences, not a biological guarantee. Failure keeps prediction plan HOLD; do not relax the floor to claim readiness.
